commit.message:
udb gem: manage espresso and must as prebuilt GitHub release binaries

Mirrors the existing Z3 pattern for espresso and must:
- Prebuilt statically-linked binaries for x64 and arm64, built on
  AlmaLinux 8 (glibc 2.28) for maximum portability
- Downloaded at gem install time via ext/ extconf.rb hooks; no local
  build toolchain required by gem users
- Binaries cached under ~/.cache/udb/{tool}/{version}/{cpu}/
- Absolute paths used at call sites in logic.rb via EspressoPath /
  MustPath helper modules

New files:
- lib/udb/ESPRESSO_VERSION, MUST_VERSION: pinned version tags
- lib/udb/espresso_version.rb, must_version.rb: Ruby version wrappers
- lib/udb/espresso_path.rb, must_path.rb: binary path helpers
- ext/udb_espresso_download/extconf.rb: download espresso at install
- ext/udb_must_download/extconf.rb: download must at install
- tools/scripts/build_espresso_with_docker.sh: Docker build script
- tools/scripts/build_must_with_docker.sh: Docker build script
- tools/scripts/README_build_espresso.md, README_build_must.md
- .github/workflows/release_tools.yml: workflow_dispatch CI to build
  and publish binaries as GitHub release assets

Modified:
- udb.gemspec: add new ext/ extensions and version files to s.files
- logic.rb: use absolute binary paths at espresso/must call sites
- .devcontainer/Dockerfile: remove manual espresso/must build steps
